scope: Resource bounds and allocation-safe rollback scratch for compound DXF POLYLINE and INSERT serialization.

behavior: POLYLINE child-handle rollback storage now uses DRW::reserve after the existing MaxOwnedObjectCount validation.
INSERT attribute chains above dwgSafety::MaxOwnedObjectCount (1,000,000) refuse before validating or staging each child.
INSERT child-handle rollback storage now uses DRW::reserve and fails through the compound output rollback path on reservation failure.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary file exports with 1,000,001 valid shared ATTRIB references refuse and preserve a pre-existing destination.
Existing INSERT rollback/retry and fresh typed readback control.
Existing compound POLYLINE/VERTEX rollback, retry, and readback controls.

limitations: The 1,000,000 child limit is an internal resource ceiling, not a DXF semantic maximum or support claim.
The DRW::reserve allocation-failure branch was not fault-injected; broader copy/work bounds and other compound writer scratch remain open.
next: Continue the P6 safety audit on remaining output assembly paths and add allocation-failure injection only where an existing seam can target the exact reserve without broad allocator changes.
